pressure_note: p0 = vapour pressure of pure solvent (water) at the temperature, measured with a dead-weight piston gauge on nitrogen; the printed phi refers to a pressure equal to the solvent vapour pressure (p = p0), not 1 atm; two p0 values marked * were calculated from steam tables

value.what: molal osmotic coefficient computed by the authors from the measured vapour-pressure difference, with non-ideal steam volumes and a compression term

value2.what: measured pressure difference p0 - p (solvent minus solution vapour pressure)

notes: Molality is the molality at the measurement temperature (it drifts from nominal 1, 2, 3 because solvent evaporates into the vapour space; the authors correct it from cell volume). Each point is the mean of 5-8 measurements.
